senses.gloss: f. (חָלַץ) taking out; untying, putting off.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:10">Tosef. Neg. VI, 10</cite> <he>בח׳</he> as regards taking out the leprous stone (<cite ref="Leviticus 14:40">Lev. XIV, 40</cite>), v. <cite ref="N01377"><he>נְתִיצָה</he></cite>.
Y. Ber. III, beg. 5ᵈ בח׳ as regards taking off the T’fillin.—Esp. (= חֲלִיצַת מַנְעָל) Hălitsah, the ceremony of taking off the Yabam’s shoe (Deut. XXV, 5—11).
Yeb. XII, 1 מצות ח׳ וכ׳ the proper way of performing the Ḥ. is before three men acting as judges.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 12:1">Ib.</cite> <he>חֲלִיצָתָהּ פסולה</he> the act &c. is invalid; a. v. fr.
